Remarks: Athlete data relevant for practical purposes and for notification purposes in the event of an ADRV. These data are not particularly sensitive.

Description: Name, Date of birth, ADAMS ID, BP ID, License number, Sport Discipline, nationality, gender, contact information (e.g., phone number(s), e-mail and mailing address(es)).
Retention Periods: Until all other associated records have been deleted (see, e.g. Article 6 – ADRV).
Remarks: Necessary to identify Athletes/other individuals, notify of ADRV, and understand who the other record categories relate to.

Description: Addresses for training and/or other locations, overnight accommodation, addresses for daily 60-minute timeslot, contact information in case Athlete cannot be found.
Retention Periods: 10 years as of end of the whereabouts quarter for which the data was submitted.
Remarks: Relevant to count 3 whereabouts failures in 12 months’ time and pursue such whereabouts failure cases following the 12-month period. Further, whereabouts remain relevant for a longer period to refine Testing strategies, e.g. based on training locations, to Results Management processes, including in cases of re-Testing or as related to the Athlete Biological Passport, and to investigations into potential ADRVs or strategies to evade Doping Controls.

Description: Log data containing dates of submission or changes to whereabouts entries.
Retention Periods: Until associated whereabouts data is deleted.
Remarks: Log data are important to understand attempts to evade Doping Controls.
